About this item

  • With a 78° fixed field of view, the C920e webcam displays individual users in a well-balanced frame, while also providing sufficient room to visually share projects and other items of interest.
  • The C920e webcam features two integrated omnidirectional microphones that capture your audio clearly from up to one meter away, so your voice always sounds natural and clear.
  • Built-in HD autofocus ensures you’re seen clearly throughout your video calls. With automatic light correction, C920e delivers optics that help you look good in all your video meetings.
  • The C920e webcam features an attachable privacy screen that flips up and down to cover or expose the lens. A simple glance at the cover confirms if the lens is able to see into your space or not.
  • The C920e webcam is certified for Zoom, TAA compliant and works with all popular video calling applications such as Microsoft Teams to ensure compatibility and seamless integration in the workplace.
  • C920e is designed with a sturdy, adjustable clip that makes it easy to mount on any laptop or external monitor. Plus 1/4" threads provide versatility to mount the webcam on a tripod as well.
  • Whether employees are in the office, at home, or somewhere else, Sync device management software helps everyone stay connected by letting you ensure their Logitech video collaboration personal devices are being used and up to date.
  • Fully compatible with Windows 11

From the manufacturer

LOOK GOOD. EVERYWHERE.

C920e is a work-from-anywhere webcam that surpasses the video and audio quality provided by most laptops. Step up to professional-quality video collaboration ideal for deployment at scale.

Previous page

  1. YOU. PERFECTLY FRAMED.

    With a 78° fixed field of view, the C920e captures a “just right” view of the user and their environment in a well-balanced frame and also provides sufficient room to visually share projects.

  2. ACTIVATE MICS WHENEVER NEEDED

    Dual integrated omnidirectional mics can be easily enabled with the Logi Tune Desktop app. When activated, the mics are optimized to clearly capture audio from up to one meter away.

  3. KEEP SHARP, AUTOMATICALLY

    Built-in HD autofocus ensures you’re seen clearly throughout video calls. Working in tandem with automatic light correction, C920e delivers optics that help you look good great in your video meetings.

  4. TAKE CONTROL WITH TUNE DESKTOP

    The Logi Tune Desktop app simplifies personal device control and customization, including microphone activation. The mini app works unobtrusively on your screen for uninterrupted video collaboration.

Next page
Previous page

  1. BUSINESS READY BY DESIGN

    Seamless compatibility with all popular video calling apps—BlueJeans, Cisco Webex, Fuze, Google Meet, Go To Meeting, Lifesize Cloud, Microsoft Teams, Pexip, Skype for Business, Vidyo, Zoom and more.

  2. VERSATILE MOUNTING OPTIONS

    A sturdy, adjustable clip makes it easy to mount C920e on any laptop or external monitor. Tripod threads add extra versatility to mount on a tabletop or full-size tripod. (Tripod sold separately)

  3. ATTACHABLE PRIVACY SHADE

    An attachable privacy screen flips up and down to cover or expose the lens. A simple glance at the physical cover confirms for sure if the lens is able to see into your space or not.

Next page

  • Compatible with Windows 7 or later, macOS 10.10 or later and Chrome OS
  • Works with popular calling platforms

Product Description

C920e is a work-from-anywhere webcam that delivers HD video meetings that look better than most laptop built-ins at a price point that’s ideal for mass deployment. The 78° diagonal field of view displays individual users in a well-balanced visual frame while two integrated omnidirectional microphones are optimized to capture your audio from up to one meter away. Built-in HD autofocus ensures you’re seen clearly when on camera, while an attachable privacy screen flips up and down to cover or expose the lens. C920e is designed with a sturdy, adjustable clip that makes it easy to mount on any laptop or external monitor. Plus it has a ¼” thread to enable mounting to a tripod. C920e is certified for Zoom®, TAA compliant and works with all popular video calling applications such as Microsoft Teams®, Google Meet™ and Cisco Webex® to ensure compatibility and seamless integration in the workplace.

    Price-Performance Ratio is Great...!!! Performance is Top-Notch...!!!
    I recently purchased a Logitech C920e HD Mic-Enabled Webcam to go with a new ASUS desktop computer running Windows 11... I was having compatibility problems with my old Logitech webcam, so I decided to treat myself to a new Logitech webcam... After some research, I landed on the Logitech C920e HD Webcam, as it fulfilled all my requirements and more... After browsing for one at several electronics stores, I ended up ordering one from Amazon due to the stores asking price of $120 versus Amazon's $62 dollars - a 50% savings...!!! It works great and is easy to install - very user-friendly - even for someone like me, who's unfamiliar/unskilled with most things technical...!!! In doing my research, I learned of the Logitech C920e Webcam's numerous functions and features - (1) 2 microphones in stereo, instead of one, so there's no need for an external microphone... (2) A nice, snap-on privacy shutter/lid that provides you with privacy when you want it... (3) A blue indicator-light lets you know when it's on and operating... (3) A tripod mount for a 1/4"-20 or a 3/8"-16 screw gives you added versatility/portability... (4) A built-in motion sensor allows you to use it as a security camera... (5) Great camera functions with a manual focus slide gives you excellent photo results... (6) A Video Recorder - 1080x30fps for high-resolution videos with Automatic Light Correction & Auto-Focus included... (7) A 78-degree Field of View (FOV) for exceptional wide-view videos... (8) A high-quality glass lens for extremely clear/sharp photos and videos versus a cheaper plastic lens... (9) 3 Megapixels for great high-resolution images... (10) A detachable cable which is convenient... (11) It is compatible with Windows/Apple IOS/Chrome/ Mac OS X... Since I take my review photos with the Logitech C920e Webcam, it has proven itself to be easy-to-use and very proficient... I am very happy with its performance, affordability, and audio quality when talking to friends, overall... Highly recommended...!!!

      I recently purchased a Logitech C920e HD Mic-Enabled Webcam to go with a new ASUS desktop computer running Windows 11... I was having compatibility problems with my old Logitech webcam, so I decided to treat myself to a new Logitech webcam... After some research, I landed on the Logitech C920e HD Webcam, as it fulfilled all my requirements and more... After browsing for one at several electronics stores, I ended up ordering one from Amazon due to the stores asking price of $120 versus Amazon's $62 dollars - a 50% savings...!!! It works great and is easy to install - very user-friendly - even for someone like me, who's unfamiliar/unskilled with most things technical...!!! In doing my research, I learned of the Logitech C920e Webcam's numerous functions and features - (1) 2 microphones in stereo, instead of one, so there's no need for an external microphone... (2) A nice, snap-on privacy shutter/lid that provides you with privacy when you want it... (3) A blue indicator-light lets you know when it's on and operating... (3) A tripod mount for a 1/4"-20 or a 3/8"-16 screw gives you added versatility/portability... (4) A built-in motion sensor allows you to use it as a security camera... (5) Great camera functions with a manual focus slide gives you excellent photo results... (6) A Video Recorder - 1080x30fps for high-resolution videos with Automatic Light Correction & Auto-Focus included... (7) A 78-degree Field of View (FOV) for exceptional wide-view videos... (8) A high-quality glass lens for extremely clear/sharp photos and videos versus a cheaper plastic lens... (9) 3 Megapixels for great high-resolution images... (10) A detachable cable which is convenient... (11) It is compatible with Windows/Apple IOS/Chrome/ Mac OS X... Since I take my review photos with the Logitech C920e Webcam, it has proven itself to be easy-to-use and very proficient... I am very happy with its performance, affordability, and audio quality when talking to friends, overall... Highly recommended...!!!

      After using the Logitech C920e HD webcam for a while, I've been consistently impressed with its performance. The 1080p video quality is crystal clear - you can see every detail without any pixelation, which makes a huge difference during video calls. Colors are true-to-life and the image stays sharp even in varying light conditions.

      The sound quality particularly stands out. The built-in microphone captures clear, crisp audio without picking up excessive background noise. My colleagues can hear me perfectly during meetings, and I don't need a separate mic setup.

      What really sets this webcam apart is its build quality. The sturdy construction feels like it's built to last, and the mounting clip is solid - no wobbling during calls. The fact that it's certified for Zoom and compatible with Microsoft Teams makes it a reliable choice for professional use.

      Pros:

      Exceptional 1080p video clarity

      Premium audio quality with clear voice capture

      Robust build quality and stable mounting system

      Official certification for major video platforms

      Would definitely recommend this for anyone looking for a dependable webcam for remote work or video conferencing."

      Pros:

      Video Quality: The 1080p resolution provides sharp and clear video, perfect for professional meetings and streaming.

      Built-in Mic: The microphone quality is good, capturing clear audio without much background noise.

      Easy Setup: Both the webcam and light are easy to set up and use.

      Lighting: The Litra Glow light provides excellent, adjustable lighting, making video calls and streams look more professional.

      Compatibility: Works seamlessly with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and other platforms.

      Cons:

      Price: The bundle is a bit pricey, but the quality of both products justifies the cost.

      Mounting: The webcam mount could be a bit more stable, but it works well with most monitors.

      Performance and Usability:

      The Logitech C920e and Litra Glow have significantly improved my video quality. The webcam provides clear, high-resolution video, and the LED light ensures I am well-lit in any environment.

      Comparison:

      Compared to other webcams and lighting solutions, this bundle offers superior quality and ease of use. The integration with professional platforms makes it a top choice for remote work and streaming.

      Conclusion:

      Overall, the Logitech C920e HD Webcam and Litra Glow Premium LED Streaming Light are a fantastic investment for anyone needing high-quality video and lighting. They are easy to use and deliver excellent results. Highly recommended.
